content.text: A new feature for the family budgeting app to help users save for a vacation over a 12-month period.
The system shall track monthly contributions toward a vacation goal.
The system shall provide a visual representation of progress.
The user shall select a specific savings plan (Relaxed, Balanced, or Strict) to determine monthly contribution amounts.
What is the target total savings amount for the vacation?
Should the chosen plan be fixed, or can users switch between plans mid-year?
Which savings plan (Relaxed, Balanced, or Strict) should be the default or recommended option? (Selection pending user input).
